brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has demanded the death penalty for a Palestinian accused of killing a settler, Al Jazeera English reported. The demand follows the fatal incident, which has intensified tensions in the occupied territory.

Ben-Gvir's call represents a hardline stance within Israel's government on responding to violence against Israeli civilians. Death penalty cases remain rare in Israel, where capital punishment has not been carried out since 1962.
dek: Jerusalem Daily: Ben-Gvir demands death penalty for Palestinian who killed settler…
title: Ben-Gvir calls for death penalty after settler killing
